# telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number_verify (Action)

Submits the verification code sent to a phone number to complete its WhatsApp registration, started by creating a telnyx_whatsapp_phone_number.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String) The verification code received by SMS or voice call.
- `phone_number` (String) The phone number.
